property_summary: After a successful withdrawReward(recipient) call that transfers out Ether, the reference contract remains unlocked so a subsequent withdrawReward(recipient) call (even if the callee's low-level call fails) will reflect that the second call does not permanently lock the contract state — i.e., the reference does not leave the contract permanently locked after a withdraw, whereas the mutant that never resets _locked can cause subsequent withdraw attempts to permanently revert; the test uses a callee that reverts on receiving Ether to trigger the observable difference.
change_summary: Remove resetting of _locked to false at the end of the modifier, leaving _locked true after a call and thus changing reentrancy-related observable behavior.
